page.overview:
What is Team Meanies?

Team Meanies (チーム イジワルズ Team Ijiwarus) is a rescue team in Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Red Rescue Team & Blue Rescue Team. They are a team who rescues people for wealth and power. They later steal the player's mail and compete with the player in a rescue mission. It is revealed in the post game that Gengar, the leader, was the human who abandoned Gardevoir after grabbing Ninetales's tail but accuses the player of being that human instead, causing the player to flee his/her home to avoid being wrongly punished. Strangely, after the player defeats the main boss of the game, Gengar rescues the player and his/her team. In the post game, the player rescues Medicham in Wish Cave, one of the hardest dungeons in the game, and is rewarded with a wish stone along with access to Wish Cave. Moreover, the player is also later given the option to escort Gengar through Murky Cave in order to meet Ninetales to repent for his sins.
